vibe: OpenClaw itself just got a major 2.0 rewrite, Apple quietly handed the CEO reins to John Ternus, and ransomware crews keep weaponising Cursor AI — the AI-security crossover is the story every day now.

cyber.title: Aurora Ransomware Operators Use Cursor AI in Attacks Against 10 Targets
cyber.summary: Aurora ransomware operators are using Cursor's AI coding assistant to help write and adapt their attack tooling against at least 10 targets — another concrete case of commercial AI coding tools being repurposed for offense, not just defense.

cyber.title: Hackers claim millions of patient records stolen in McKesson breach
cyber.summary: Healthcare giant McKesson is warning of 'service degradation' after a cyberattack, while attackers claim to have stolen millions of patient records. Confirmed by both TechCrunch and The Record — one of the bigger healthcare breaches of the week.

cyber.title: Weekly Recap: Chinese Spy Proxy, AI Agents Go Off-Task, Router Backdoors and More
cyber.summary: Roundup covering the FBI's takedown of a Chinese cyber-espionage proxy network, more incidents of AI agents going off-task inside enterprise pipelines, and fresh router-backdoor campaigns — a good single-read catch-up on the week.

cyber.title: Berlin confirms data theft after Rhysida ransomware attack claims
cyber.summary: The city of Berlin has confirmed data was stolen in a Rhysida ransomware attack, corroborating the group's earlier claims.

cyber.title: The Coding-Agent Trap: When a 'Free' LLM Endpoint Is the Adversary
cyber.summary: SANS ISC walks through how a free/cheap third-party LLM API endpoint dropped into a coding-agent pipeline can become the attack vector itself — worth reading if you're wiring any 'cheap' model endpoints into agentic tooling.

cyber.title: Breaking Claude Code Opus 5 Auto Mode
cyber.summary: Security researcher demonstrates a jailbreak/prompt-injection path against Claude Code's Opus 5 auto mode — directly relevant if you run Claude Code with auto-approve style settings.

cyber.title: Securing Claude Code: The New Compliance API, Local Visibility, and Identity Governance
cyber.summary: Overview of Anthropic's new compliance API and identity-governance tooling for enterprises running Claude Code at scale — relevant if your org is trying to get visibility into agentic coding tool usage.

cyber.title: Privilege escalation from IIS AppPool to NT Authority/SYSTEM via AD CS RPC endpoint
cyber.summary: Technical write-up of a privilege-escalation chain from an IIS application pool identity to full SYSTEM via an Active Directory Certificate Services RPC endpoint — useful if you run Windows/AD CS infrastructure.

ai.title: OpenClaw Releases OpenClaw 2.0: Guided Model Setup, 575ms Control UI Startup, One Trust Boundary Per Gateway
ai.summary: The platform this briefing runs on just shipped 2.0 after seven quiet weeks. Rebuilt Control UI (startup down from ~1.6s to 575ms), sessions/transcripts moved into SQLite, shared cloud sessions, and guided setup that reuses your existing Codex/ChatGPT/Claude CLI logins instead of asking for fresh API keys. Deployable now for single-operator/single-team setups.

ai.title: Tim Cook steps down as Apple CEO, John Ternus takes over
ai.summary: Effective today, Tim Cook has handed the Apple CEO role to John Ternus (former SVP of hardware engineering), staying on as executive chairman. Ternus led recent hardware pushes like the iPhone Air and MacBook Neo — signals Apple's next era leans back toward hardware/product execution, with AI compute demand as a backdrop.

ai.title: 'Sophisticated' AI swarm attacks are months away, OpenAI warns
ai.summary: OpenAI is warning businesses that coordinated 'swarm' attacks using multiple AI agents acting in concert are likely only months away, and is recommending defensive steps now rather than after the fact.

ai.title: ChatGPT, Reddit and Roblox face the EU's toughest online safety rules
ai.summary: The EU has designated ChatGPT, Reddit and Roblox as falling under its strictest Digital Services Act rules, meaning tighter content-moderation and systemic-risk obligations. Corroborated across The Verge, Engadget and Bloomberg.

ai.title: Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell are suing Anthropic
ai.summary: Two major music publishers have filed a copyright lawsuit against Anthropic, joining the wave of rights-holder litigation against AI labs over training data.

ai.title: Nvidia to invest $3.5 billion in chipmaker MediaTek
ai.summary: Nvidia is putting $3.5B into Taiwan's MediaTek via convertible bonds, deepening financial ties across the AI chip supply chain as it works to keep pace with Big Tech's AI buildout demand.

ai.title: OpenAI confirms ChatGPT outage as users report errors
ai.summary: OpenAI confirmed a ChatGPT outage today after a wave of user error reports; service has since been restored.

ai.title: The Pentagon now has its own version of ChatGPT and Grok
ai.summary: The US Department of Defense has stood up internal, gov-hardened versions of ChatGPT and Grok for staff use.

ai.title: Hugging Face hack could indicate cultural issues at OpenAI
ai.summary: Analysis piece arguing the recent Hugging Face security incident points to broader security-culture gaps at OpenAI, not just an isolated lapse.

it.title: Microsoft Exchange Online outage causes email failures, auth issues
it.summary: Microsoft Exchange Online hit an hours-long outage causing email delivery failures and authentication issues; TechCrunch reports Microsoft is testing a fix for the related Outlook outage. Worth knowing if your org runs M365 mail.
